description: Header file defining the PackageManagerImplementation class, which implements package downloading, installation, and handling interfaces for a plugin in the WPEFramework. It includes class definitions, method declarations, and internal data structures related to package management.

classes.name: PackageManagerImplementation
classes.description: Implements package download, installation, and handling interfaces for the plugin, managing package states, downloads, and telemetry.

classes.name: State
classes.description: Represents the state of a package, including install status, lock count, runtime config, and related metadata.

classes.name: BlockedInstallData
classes.description: Holds data related to blocked installation attempts, including version, key-values, and file locator.

classes.name: Configuration
classes.description: JSON configuration container for download directory setting.

classes.name: DownloadInfo
classes.description: Stores information about a download task, including URL, ID, retries, rate limit, and status.

methods.name: getRuntimeConfig
methods.description: Static method to populate runtime configuration from package metadata or existing config.

methods.name: recordAndPublishTelemetryData
methods.description: Records and publishes telemetry data related to package operations (enabled via macro).

methods.name: getCurrentTimestamp
methods.description: Returns the current timestamp (enabled via macro).
